body.code_violation_desc: Additional work permit required. An inspection at 570 Carmelita revealed Excavation before a shoring permit has been issued. On the South property line wall a section approx 20' feet in length by appx 5ft in depth has been dug out. As well as a few gradebeams within the property, with shoring installed very close to the holes without engineer direction. Code/Section: SFBC 102A, SFBC 106A.4.7 Monthly monitoring fee applies. Code/Section: SFBC 110A, Table 1A-K

A phone complaint was received 11/17/2020 about over excavation.
